errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are not placed at equal intervals. The time difference between ticks is not constant (4 years, 1 year, 4 years, 4 years), and the visual spacing also reflects this, with 2012 and 2013 being very close together.
In Graph A, the y-axis has labeled ticks at 40, 44, 48, and 52, which represents an interval of 4, not 2.
The description incorrectly groups two distinct data points. The value in 2013 is 52, but the value in 2012 is approximately 50.
The data point for 2021 in Graph A is clearly below the 40 mark on the y-axis, at a value of approximately 37.
The y-axis scale in Graph B shows labels from 0 to 3, but the data extends beyond this range, with the 2021 data point being at approximately 3.5.
In Graph B, the value for 2008 is approximately 1.5%, not 2.25%.
The description incorrectly groups two distinct data points with an incorrect value. In 2012, the value is ~0.5%, and in 2013 it is even lower (~0.3%). Both are lower than the stated 0.75%.
In Graph B, the value for 2017 is approximately 1.2%, not 0.75%.
In Graph B, the value for 2021 is the highest point on the graph, at approximately 3.5%, not 2.5%.
The description fails to mention that the data points on both line plots are indicated with black circular markers.
